65004.d: Kaanel täisplastiline ažuurne lillekimp, samasugustest azuursetest õitest ja lehtedest palistus jaluse ja tüvise vahel. Kaanel üks rida poolkerajaid kühme jalusel ja kupal kaks rida. Kühmude vahel madalreljeefsed abstraktsed motiivid.
65004.de: On the lid a fully sculptural openwork bouquet of flowers, a border of similarly openwork flowers and leaves between the base and the stem. On the lid one row of hemispherical bosses on the base and two rows on the body. Between the bosses low-relief abstract motifs.

65552.d: Väga haruldane, rikkalikult kaunistatud kullatud hõbedast tseremoniaalne kann avardab oluliselt teadmisi Eesti 17. sajandi kullassepakunstist. Eseme muudab eriti väärtuslikuks dekoor graveeritud figuuridest ajastuomases riietuses.
65552.de: A very rare, richly decorated ceremonial jug of gilded silver significantly expands the knowledge of 17th-century Estonian goldsmith's art. What makes the object especially valuable is the decor of engraved figures in period-typical clothing.
